Design:
- Separate strata.serve-first-row-sidecar.v1, capture-receipt.v1 and comparison.v1 schemas. Lazy dispatch in existing receipt/comparator. Existing standalone parser, provider semantics, N>=2 admission and empty REVIEWED_PRODUCERS are untouched.
- Reviewed static registry contains only actual K request2. No arbitrary raw-file registration, no runtime registry switch, no candidate P registration. Additional producers require explicit Main actual qualification and source-reviewed static tuple/hash update.
- Authenticate original receipt PASS/complete/inactive, source/binary/provider/model pre/post, fixture, requestpacket, READY PID/start, owner normalexit/reap/empty session, normalQUIT/no fallback signals, actual COPIED before COMPLETE, closed finite row hash/header/endian/bytes/position, output selfargmax solely producer consistency, fresh complete health/kernel observations and hashes, sameboot/filter/count/no fault.
- Use original embedded owner evidence and pinned retirement manifest; do not reopen retired successful rawlogs or request1/partial files. Current selected row and consumer/review required. Pin bytebudgets before hashing and rehash tracked files on return. Source Git identity read-only with bounded timeout. No model tensors read.
- Pairwise one-row comparison adapts both arms from source/receipt pins, requires equal entire conditioning/model/tokenizer identity, numericargv and effectiveenv (capture directory excluded), and returns NLL/logp/rank/top1/top2margin/KL only. All quality/fullphysical256K/RESTORE/performance flags false. No corpusquality, zeroabilityloss, generationtextqualitygate or adoption claim.
- Japanese-first and same-change English docs describe format (no magic; exact native LE header), schemas, explicit qualification limits and serialized Main commands.

Retired siblings are optional.
2. Run existing CPU suites sequentially: tools/test_fixed_history_capture_receipt.py then tools/test_fixed_history_logits.py, with PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.
3. Main's exclusive slot: python3 tools/fixed_history_capture_receipt.py tools/serve_first_row_example.json.
   This imports the ACTUAL retained32K row, original receipt, source and fixed conditioning fixture only; no inference.
4. Main's exclusive slot: python3 tools/fixed_history_logits.py tools/serve_first_row_self_comparison.json.
   K-versus-K verifies plumbing only. Zero deltas prove no candidate quality. This source includes a fixed example manifest and sidecar pins for Main review.
5. Review outputs and source pins. Only after a candidate is actually qualified, register its exact tuple in a reviewed source change, and run a bounded paired comparison with identical frozen conditioning. Candidate P currently SOURCEONLY unqualified; remains blocked from registration.
6. Main records actual status/individual CPU and adapter results then commits/pushes source/docs/compact evidence at its boundary. No cleanup here.
